note: Every direct dependency must be listed here with why it exists. npm run lint fails on anything new: adding a package is a decision, not a side effect.

dependencies.@capacitor/browser: Google sign-in in the system browser
dependencies.@capacitor/splash-screen: native splash (configured in capacitor.config.ts, no JS import)
dependencies.exifr: photo date from EXIF, then stripped
dependencies.zod: validates every request and model response
